binding_note: This sidecar exists because the anchor entry schema admits no additional fields -- the model refuses an entry with unbound keys. It is bound to the entry by epoch id AND entry digest, so a chain edit invalidates the binding rather than leaving stale prose beside a changed chain.
note: The tool forces every entry divergent from the immutable comparison baseline onto the latest epoch date. Each forced entry is either MATERIALLY REVIEWED (drifted handler-closure or registration anchor, rebound against discovery, classification independently validated by the tool against observed effect calls) or MECHANICALLY UNCHANGED-CONFIRMED (looked at and verified still matching discovery on both anchors). Entries identical to the baseline are NOT restamped: moving an unchanged entry would be a review claim with nothing behind it.
location_note: Lives outside docs/evidence/m0-program-control/ because that directory is a CLOSED generated set -- M0 refuses any artifact it did not write. The binding is by epoch id and entry digest, so location is incidental and tamper-evidence is not.
